title: Schedules
emptyBody: Run scenarios on a timetable, on the server, with the schedule's own values.
viewerHint: You can view schedules. Editors and admins can change them.

reason.variable_missing: A personal variable has no schedule value
reason.auth_session_missing: The schedule has no login session
reason.storage_low: The server was low on storage
reason.not_found: A scenario or the environment is gone
reason.invalid_request: A scenario belongs to another site

edit.name: Name
edit.scenariosHint: In this order. Scenarios of the environment's site.
edit.tagHint: Chosen when the schedule fires; archived scenarios are left out.
edit.cronHint: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.
edit.overlap: If the last run is still going
edit.deleteBody: Its fire history and its own values are deleted too. Runs it started stay.
edit.resetBody: The new environment has other variables, so the {count} values set for this schedule are deleted.

values.title: Schedule values
values.intro: Unattended runs use only these values for the environment's personal variables. Nobody's own value stands in.
values.none: This environment has no personal variables.
values.saveFirst: Save the schedule first, then add its values.

session.title: Login session
session.notNeeded: This environment doesn't use login sessions.
session.missing: None yet. Fires are refused until you make one.
session.sent: Opened a browser in your desktop app. Log in there and the session is saved for this schedule.
session.errorDesktop: Your desktop app is not connected.
session.errorUpdate: Update the desktop app to save a schedule's session.

fires.title: Fire history
fires.missedRange: {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} until {until}
